title: The Hungry Bear
text:
Once there was a little bear. He lived in a dark forest near a lake. Every day, he looked for honey.

One day, the bear found a big jar of honey near a tree. He ate all the honey and fell asleep. When he woke up, he was happy and full.

options: In a dark forest near a lake

questions.text: Why was the bear happy at the end of the story?
options: He had eaten a lot of honey
He got a gift from a friend

questions.text: What kind of character is the bear?

vocabulary.definition: a large animal with thick fur
a sweet, sticky food made by bees
a glass container with a lid

paragraph_translations: Колись жив маленький ведмідь. Він жив у темному лісі біля озера. Щодня він шукав мед.
Одного дня ведмідь знайшов велику банку меду біля дерева. Він з'їв увесь мед і заснув. Коли він прокинувся, він був щасливий і ситий.
